title: W10 consumes authoritative field provenance, deleting the container heuristic
description:
W10 (`eshyra-o9bd.19.12`) consumption step for PR #543 re-review finding 1.

WORKTREE `.worktrees/eshyra-o9bd.19.12.11`, BRANCH `eshyra-o9bd.19.12.11`, cut
from `eshyra-o9bd.19.12` at the merge of `eshyra-o9bd.19.1.3.1`.

## Ownership

`eshyra-o9bd.19.1.3.1` (a child of `eshyra-o9bd.19.1.3`) OWNS the provenance
representation, the declarations, the fail-closed gate, and the emitted
`field-provenance.json`. It is already merged into your base branch. **You do
not modify any of it.** W10 is purely a CONSUMER here. If the fact is wrong or
insufficient, record it with `bd update` and file a follow-up against
`eshyra-o9bd.19.1.3.1` — do not fix it in discovery code.

## What exists on your base branch

- `packages/core/src/rules/fieldProvenance.ts` — `FieldProvenanceClass`
  (`source-prose` | `source-derived` | `compiler-projection`),
  `FieldProvenanceManifest`, `classifyFieldPointer(manifest, kind, pointer)`
  (returns `undefined` when nothing covers the pointer — deliberately),
  `walkFieldPointers`, `buildFieldProvenanceManifest`.
- `packages/core/src/rules/packLoader.ts` — `loadFieldProvenanceManifest`,
  `PACK_FIELD_PROVENANCE_FILE`; `loadRulesPackFromDirectory` exposes it.
- `packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/field-provenance.json`
  — 207 declarations covering all 68,231 emitted leaves, all 16 record kinds.
- All of the above are exported from `packages/core/src/internal.ts`.

Pointer convention, which you must match exactly: pointers are rooted at
`data` and every array index is collapsed to the literal segment `*`, so
`actions[5].mechanics.damage[0].dice` classifies as
`/actions/*/mechanics/damage/*/dice`.

## The defect being closed

`packet.ts` currently splits a record body with `PROJECTION_CONTAINER_KEYS`, a
consumer-side heuristic. It is the SECOND such heuristic and the re-review
rejected a third. It classifies `creature:adult-black-dragon`
`armorClass.value: 19` — a parser product — as `sourceMaterial`, which the
renderer then presents under "Source prose (verbatim; authoritative)".

## What to change

1. **Delete `PROJECTION_CONTAINER_KEYS` and the container walk** in
   `packages/core/src/discovery/packet.ts`. Classify each leaf by asking the
   pack's manifest. Nothing in discovery may keep a fallback name list.
2. **Three buckets on `PacketCandidate`, not two.** `sourceMaterial` /
   `projection` becomes a partition over the three real classes. Name them for
   what they are; `source-derived` is neither verbatim prose nor an
   interpretive projection, and collapsing it into either is the defect in a
   new form.
3. **The renderer states each honestly.** Only `source-prose` may appear under
   "Source prose (verbatim; authoritative)". `source-derived` gets its own
   heading saying plainly that these are deterministic parser products of the
   cited source and are NOT verbatim quotations. `compiler-projection` keeps
   the existing typed-projection heading and its "does not replace the source
   prose above" line. Projection-limit notes stay in band beside the
   projection they qualify.
4. **A pointer the manifest does not cover is a residue entry**, disclosed in
   band exactly as the existing `residue` list is — never silently assigned to
   a bucket. `classifyFieldPointer` returns `undefined` for a reason.
5. **The pack may ship no manifest at all** (`loadFieldProvenanceManifest` is
   optional, and an add-on pack in the test corpus may lack one). Decide that
   case deliberately and write the reasoning down: discovery must not claim
   "verbatim; authoritative" for material whose provenance nothing attests.
   Whatever you choose, a reader must be able to tell "attested prose" from
   "unattested content" in the delivered text.
6. Follow the shape change through `measurements.ts` (M9's `exactSubstring`
   and `typedPath` matching, M8's attribution check) and `shadow.ts`'s v2
   admission.

## Evidence required

Use REAL records through the offline harness. Do not hand-author a packet, and
do not derive expectations from the declaration table — derive them from the
record and assert the delivered text.

E1. `creature:adult-black-dragon`: `armorClass/sourceText` under source prose;
    `armorClass/value` and `armorClass/source` under source-derived, NOT under
    the verbatim heading; `actions/*/text` under source prose;
    `actions/*/mechanics` under projection.
E2. The sibling class the re-review named: hit points, speed, ability scores
    and structured statline metadata all render as source-derived, never as
    verbatim prose.
E3. `spell:fireball`: `description` and `higherLevels` verbatim under source
    prose; `mechanics.saves[0].ability` and `damageOnSuccess` under projection;
    "a 20-foot-radius sphere" still present verbatim.
E4. A generic sweep over every retained candidate of at least one probe: no
    pointer whose manifest class is `source-derived` or `compiler-projection`
    appears under the verbatim heading. This must be driven from the manifest
    at assertion time, so a future reclassification moves the test with it.
E5. The no-manifest case from item 5, asserting whatever you decided.
E6. M9 still reports zero missing facts for every probe that reported zero
    before, including P8's typed path `/data/mechanics/economies/use`.

## Non-negotiables

- `npm run verify:worktree` from the worktree root BEFORE committing.
- Biome is canonical; CI fails on warnings.
- Do not weaken or skip an existing test. Tests encoding the container
  heuristic SHOULD change — name each and why.
- Do not edit `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, anything under `.claude/`, the design
  document, or anything owned by `eshyra-o9bd.19.1.3.1`.
- Known flake: `packages/cli/test/cli.test.ts > packs publishable tarballs`
  times out at 10s under full-suite load. Pre-existing, filed, unrelated.
notes:
IMPLEMENTED at efcca14 (branch eshyra-o9bd.19.12.11). Deleted PROJECTION_CONTAINER_KEYS and the container walk in packet.ts; every PacketCandidate leaf is now classified by reading eshyra-o9bd.19.1.3.1's field-provenance manifest (classifyFieldPointer, per (kind, normalized-pointer)) instead of guessing from a container name.

TEST COUNTS: baseline 738518c 5361 passed/20 skipped. After efcca14: npm run verify:worktree clean (format/check/typecheck all green), npm run test 5364 passed/20 skipped (net +3: bead-E1, bead-E2, bead-E5 below). Known flake packages/cli/test/cli.test.ts > packs publishable tarballs confirmed standalone-green (1 passed/14 skipped), consistent with the filed pre-existing full-suite-load flake; not touched.

SHAPE CHANGE: PacketCandidate.sourceMaterial -> sourceProse + sourceDerived (projection kept its name/heading). RecordDataResidue gained `reason: 'unrepresentable-shape' | 'no-provenance-declaration'`. Threaded through measurements.ts (M9's present-check now searches all three buckets) and shadow.ts's discovery-shadow-v2 admission (same schema tag, no version bump, matching the precedent the F2 repair already set for this shape). M8's attribution check (forbiddenPresent/unattributedPresent) touches only candidate.provenance, never sourceMaterial/projection, so it needed no code change — verified unaffected by re-running discoveryProbes.test.ts (m8.forbiddenPresent/unattributedPresent still []).

MANIFEST WIRING: field-provenance classification is declared per RulesRecordKind, not per pack identity (fieldProvenance.ts's own doc comment has no packId dimension), so one bundled manifest applies to every SRD-compatible stack: added getBundledDnd5eSrdFieldProvenanceManifest() to rules/bundledSrdPack.ts (cached like the pack itself, loaded via the already-existing loadFieldProvenanceManifest(PACK_DIR)), and discovery/harness.ts now passes it as buildContextPacket's new 4th (optional) parameter. This covers the hand-authored test-corpus add-ons too (cursedAttunementAddon, variantReadinessAddon) because their new fields all nest under already-declared containers (mechanics, executionReadiness) — verified their tests still pass unchanged.

NO-MANIFEST DECISION (design item 5): buildContextPacket's fieldProvenanceManifest parameter defaults to undefined, and classifyRecordBody treats undefined IDENTICALLY to a manifest that declares nothing — classifyFieldPointer is never called, every leaf becomes 'no-provenance-declaration' residue, nothing lands in sourceProse/sourceDerived/projection. Reasoning: a pack attesting nothing must never be read as attesting verbatim source authority merely because the manifest argument was omitted; collapsing "no manifest" into "declares nothing" needed no special-cased second code path and is exercised directly as evidence (packetMessage.test.ts "bead-E5"), which calls the REAL buildContextPacket a second time over a REAL RetentionTrace the offline harness already produced for creature:adult-black-dragon, manifest argument omitted, and asserts every one of its ~40 leaves (armorClass.value included) is disclosed as residue rather than appearing under any classified heading.

POINTER COVERAGE: none found uncovered. Manually cross-checked every typedPath/exactSubstring fixture fact across all 12 diagnostic probes (P1-P12) against the real 207-declaration field-provenance.json by (kind, pointerPrefix, class) — every one resolves to a declared class (verified with a standalone python check reproducing classifyFieldPointer's most-specific-prefix rule). The only residue produced anywhere in the full suite is bead-E5's deliberate no-manifest case; every real SRD-pack-sourced leaf reachable through the fixture corpus classifies cleanly. Adventure-entity candidates are outside the manifest's scope entirely (adventure-entity is not a RulesRecordKind) and are kept wholesale under sourceProse, matching the prior no-op behavior for authored module content.

EXISTING TESTS CHANGED, and why:
- packetMessage.test.ts "F2 -> F2/F1-rr - P10 splits its governing spell:fireball record the same way as P4": spell:fireball's `components` field is manifest-classified source-derived (a parsed V/S/M token list), not source-prose, so its assertion moved from the verbatim heading to the new source-derived heading.
- packetMessage.test.ts "F2 - no string-valued projection leaf appears under Source prose..." REPLACED by "bead-E4 - no source-derived or compiler-projection leaf appears under Source prose, for every retained candidate": rewritten to be driven from the manifest AT ASSERTION TIME per the bead's explicit E4 requirement - it independently re-walks each retained candidate's real record (fetched fresh via getBundledDnd5eSrdPack(), not derived from the packet under test) and classifies every leaf with the same classifyFieldPointer the producer uses, so a future manifest reclassification moves this test's own expectation rather than needing a hand update. Also now catches source-derived leaks, which the old test (string-typed projection leaves only) could not.
- campaignRuleConsumption.test.ts: `candidate?.sourceMaterial` -> `candidate?.sourceProse` (field rename only; same claim - verbatim SRD description prose survives beside an active house rule).
- support/factEvidence.ts `proseOf()`: combines all three buckets (sourceProse/sourceDerived/projection) instead of two (sourceMaterial/projection); used by encounter-identity-retained and house-rule-governs-beside-source evidenceNotes assertions, neither of which changed semantically.
- shadowEvidenceIntegrity.test.ts: comment-only update explaining why the cursed-attunement add-on's curse still classifies as `projection` even though its own pack ships no manifest (kind-keyed, not pack-keyed, classification).
- support/discoveryOwnership.ts: added ../rules/fieldProvenance.js to REVIEWED_FOREIGN_DEPENDENCIES (packet.ts now imports classifyFieldPointer/FieldProvenanceManifest from it), with a comment naming the review basis.
No test was weakened or skipped; every change either renamed a field reference to match the new shape or strengthened a check to be manifest-driven.

NOT MODIFIED (ownership respected): fieldProvenance.ts, packLoader.ts, scripts/importers/, data/rules-packs/ - confirmed zero diff via `git diff --stat` against those paths before committing.

CONCERN ABOUT THE PROVENANCE FACT CONSUMED: none identified. The manifest matched every real-pack leaf exercised by the fixture corpus and the full test suite (5364 passed/20 skipped, zero unintended residue). No follow-up filed against eshyra-o9bd.19.1.3.1.

Did not push, open a PR, or touch eshyra-o9bd.19.12 or eshyra-o9bd.19.1.3.1 per task scope; integration is the dispatching agent's.
